name: ai.speko/mcp-calls
title: agentvoice - AI calls for coding agents (by Speko)
description: Place real, disclosed outbound phone calls to businesses, or call your verified owner for remote control, straight from your coding agent.

environmentVariables.name: SPEKO_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Required in default single-process mode. Your Speko API key (sk_...); get one at https://platform.speko.dev. In remote mode this key belongs on the backing server instead.

environmentVariables.name: SPEKO_MCP_SERVER_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional: route through a hosted/remote Speko backing server instead of running in-process. When set, the API key lives on that server, not here.

environmentVariables.name: SPEKO_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Client timeout profile written by init. In remote mode the MCP forwards only a known profile; unknown or missing values use poll-safe defaults.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_INTERNAL_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional shared secret for remote mode. Set the same value on the MCP client and backing server; required when that server binds a non-loopback address.
